# AI rules — Browser client (vanilla JavaScript)

Scope: `public/scripts/**`, `public/index.html`, `tests/**` — the whole client: plain JavaScript ES modules,
no build step, no TypeScript. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) §4.1 and §5 for where this sits.
Generic web-UI rules (file layout, no inline CSS/JS, accessibility, the ~800-line limit) live in
[AI.md](AI.md); colours, typography and components live in [AI_WEB_DESIGN_SQOWE.md](AI_WEB_DESIGN_SQOWE.md);
the serverless proxy rules live in [AI_PROXY.md](AI_PROXY.md). This file is the coding contract for the
client logic only.

## Modules and libraries

- ES modules only (`<script type="module" src="scripts/main.js">`). No CommonJS, no bundler, no TypeScript.
- Third-party libraries (Pako, Fuse.js, Snowball) are local files in `public/vendor/`, loaded by classic
  `<script>` tags in `index.html` and used as globals. Add a new library the same way — never from a CDN.
- Put new logic in a new module under `utils/` or `components/` instead of growing a big file, as
  `utils/liveChannels.js` did for `main.js`. `cinemaTab.js` is already over the AI.md limit; `channelFilter.js`
  and `main.js` are close to it.

## State and storage

- Shared runtime state is `window.appState` (declared in `main.js`). Add a new field there, with a comment and
  a safe default (`null`, `[]`). The Cinema tab keeps its own module-scoped `cinemaState`; do not mix the two.
- Saved settings go through `utils/storage.js` only: add the key to `STORAGE_KEYS` (prefix `iptv_`) and a
  save/get pair that wraps `localStorage` in `try/catch`, like the existing ones. A key left out of
  `STORAGE_KEYS` is not removed by `clearStorage()`.
- Two modules own their key and keep it: `utils/ratings.js` (`epg_ratings`) and `components/channelFilter.js`
  (`iptv-channel-filter`). Do not read or write those keys from anywhere else.

## Safe HTML

- Every dynamic value that goes into `innerHTML` or an `href` passes through `utils/sanitize.js`:
  `escapeHtml` for text, `escapeAttr` for attribute values, `sanitizeUrl` for links (http/https only).
  For a link: `sanitizeUrl` first, then `escapeAttr`. Use `textContent` when no markup is needed.
- External stream links use `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
- New code imports from `sanitize.js`. Do not add another local copy; the older local copies in
  `results.js`, `channelFilter.js` and `cinemaTab.js` stay until a separate cleanup is requested.

## Time

- `program.start` and `program.stop` come from `parseEpgTime()`, which drops the timezone offset, and
  `getProgramStatus()` compares those values. Neither is reliable as an absolute time when the browser is
  not in the EPG's zone.
- Anything absolute (catch-up `utc`, the archive window, "is this in the past" for playback) is computed with
  `epgRawToEpochSeconds(program.startRaw / stopRaw)`. It returns `NaN` for bad input: check `isNaN` and hide
  the feature instead of building a URL.

## Network

- Provider URLs (EPG, M3U) are fetched only through `fetchEpgData` and `fetchM3uData`. They use
  `/api/proxy?url=…` except on `localhost` / `127.0.0.1`. Never call `fetch` on a provider URL elsewhere and
  never hardcode the proxy path elsewhere.
- Secondary loads (such as `loadLiveChannels`) are non-blocking: catch the error, log it, and show no
  feature rather than an error. They never delay or fail the EPG load.
- A load the user can restart cancels the previous one with `AbortController`, as `cinemaTab.js` does.

## Tests

- Tests run in the browser: each `tests/*.test.js` exports `runTests()` and is registered in
  `tests/test-runner.html`. There is no command-line runner. Add or extend a test next to any util you change.
- Serve the repository root (`python3 -m http.server 8000`) and open `/tests/test-runner.html`.
  `npm run dev` serves only `public/`, so it cannot reach `tests/`.
- Run `node --check <file>` on every JavaScript file you touch. No linter or typecheck is configured.
